title: Dexter's Laboratory Theme
blurb: Frantic, brassy and faintly Eastern European, the Dexter's Laboratory theme sounded like nothing else on Cartoon Network in 1996. Genndy Tartakovsky's show about a boy genius with an unplaceable accent and a secret lab behind a bookcase ran on exactly that energy, and the title sequence establishes the whole premise in about eight seconds flat. It is a pure, uncut hit of nineties cartoon nostalgia, and it has aged rather better than most of the decade around it. Play it just before doing something ill-advised in a garage.
origin: The title theme from Dexter's Laboratory (Cartoon Network, 1996).
